Разбившийся самолёт

A crashed aircraft with valuable loot and a Captain Keycard.

Что делать

Search the nose first: a player reported finding the card there. The nose is a pickup area.

Награды

The plane holds valuable loot; the card cannot be crafted. Look for another reader after finding it.

Риски

The card does not work in the cockpit and is not guaranteed on every search. Watch for other players.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
